editorial.title: Synthetic release incident for preview verification
editorial.summary: A synthetic incident exercises source attribution, unknown values and same-day publication. This is a fixture, not a report of a real compromise.
editorial.why_it_matters: The exercise shows how a release can cross a software trust boundary.
editorial.action: For this synthetic exercise, examine build records and retain evidence before deciding what to replace.

sections.heading: What is known
paragraphs: This synthetic exercise describes an untrusted release and an investigation by a fictional maintainer. It exists only to verify the newspaper's candidate preview and publication controls.
Affected versions, fixed versions and exploitation remain unknown. This fixture must never be promoted to production.
